description: Puffin Colony's hooks, the ones `colony hooks install` writes, and its first run

hooks.command: [ -f "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.colony/hooks/wait_guard.py" ] && grep -qsF .colony/hooks/wait_guard.py "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/settings.json" "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/settings.local.json" && exit 0; f="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/colony/hooks/wait_guard.py"; [ -f "$f" ] || exit 0; if python3 -V >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec python3 "$f"; elif python -V >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec python "$f"; else exec py -3 "$f"; fi

command -v colony >/dev/null 2>&1 && grep -qsF 'colony hooks asking' "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/settings.json" "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/settings.local.json" && exit 0; [ -n "$COLONY_SESSION" ] && command -v "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/colony" >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && exec "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/colony" hooks asking

command -v colony >/dev/null 2>&1 && grep -qsF 'colony hooks stopped' "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/settings.json" "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/settings.local.json" && exit 0; [ -n "$COLONY_SESSION" ] && command -v "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/colony" >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && exec "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/colony" hooks stopped

command -v colony >/dev/null 2>&1 && grep -qsF 'colony hooks unread' "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/settings.json" "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/settings.local.json" && exit 0; [ -n "$COLONY_SESSION" ] && command -v "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/colony" >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" 2>/dev/null && "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/colony" hooks unread; exit 0

command -v colony >/dev/null 2>&1 && grep -qsF 'colony hooks unread' "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/settings.json" "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/settings.local.json" && exit 0; [ -n "$COLONY_SESSION" ] && command -v "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/colony" >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" 2>/dev/null && "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/colony" hooks unread; exit 0

command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1 || [ -x "$HOME/.local/bin/uv" ] && exit 0; if command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1; then curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh; else wget -qO- https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh; fi 2>/dev/null | sh >/dev/null 2>&1; if command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1 || [ -x "$HOME/.local/bin/uv" ]; then printf '%s\n' '{"systemMessage": "Puffin Colony installed uv, which runs the colony command, with Astral'"'"'s installer (https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh).", "hookSpecificOutput": {"hookEventName": "SessionStart", "additionalContext": "Puffin Colony installed uv, which runs the colony command, with Astral'"'"'s installer (https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh)."}}'; else printf '%s\n' '{"systemMessage": "Puffin Colony could not install uv, which runs the colony command: install it from https://docs.astral.sh/uv/ and start a new session.", "hookSpecificOutput": {"hookEventName": "SessionStart", "additionalContext": "Puffin Colony could not install uv, which runs the colony command: install it from https://docs.astral.sh/uv/ and start a new session."}}'; fi; exit 0
